name: Dune: Awakening (test)
author: valentin95150@hotmail.fr
description: Dune: Awakening dedicated server (Funcom). Runs the full Linux battlegroup: Postgres, two RabbitMQ brokers, Battlegroup Director, Text Router, Gateway, mock-Kubernetes API, and on-demand UE5 instances for the always-warm hub maps (Survival_1, Overmap, DeepDesert_1) plus dungeons / Deep Desert / story missions. Installs from Steam app 4754530 (retail) or 3104830 (PTC) anonymously; both depots are open. Orchestration lives in the companion yolk (ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/games:dune_awakening) which mirrors AMP's PreStartStages chain from CubeCoders/AMPTemplates (MIT).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Dune: Awakening — Pelican install script
#
# Runs in the standard Pelican installer container (debian) with root
# and writes to /mnt/server (becomes /home/container at runtime). The
# companion yolk image (ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/games:dune_awakening) owns
# all runtime orchestration; this install step just lays down files.
#
# Steps:
#   1. apt install build-time deps
#   2. SteamCMD download of the Funcom dedicated-server depot
#        - 4754530 = Production (retail)
#        - 3104830 = PTC (public test)
#     Both anonymous-accessible. ~5 GB compressed.
#   3. Fetch CubeCoders' MIT-licensed launch scripts from AMPTemplates.
#   4. Run scripts/install.sh to extract the 7 OCI image tarballs and
#      patchelf the musl-linked binaries onto each rootfs's own loader.

set -euo pipefail

SRCDS_APPID="${SRCDS_APPID:-4754530}"
STEAM_USER="${STEAM_USER:-anonymous}"
STEAM_PASS="${STEAM_PASS:-}"
STEAM_AUTH="${STEAM_AUTH:-}"

case "$SRCDS_APPID" in
    4754530|3104830) ;;
    *)
        echo "ERROR: SRCDS_APPID must be 4754530 (retail) or 3104830 (PTC); got '$SRCDS_APPID'" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo "==> Installing build-time dependencies..."
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -q
# lib32stdc++6 + lib32gcc-s1 are BOTH required — SteamCMD's app-manifest
# verification uses 32-bit C++ paths that fail with "Missing configuration"
# if libstdc++ isn't present alongside libgcc. The community Dune guide
# at github.com/adainrivers/dune-dedicated-server-manager confirms.
apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates curl tar gzip jq file patchelf \
    lib32gcc-s1 lib32stdc++6

# Pre-create SteamCMD state directories under $HOME with sane ownership.
# SteamCMD creates these on the fly otherwise, but failures inside
# unprivileged install containers have been traced to missing ~/.steam
# and ~/Steam pre-creation.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/server /mnt/server/steamapps \
    /mnt/server/.steam /mnt/server/Steam

echo "==> Downloading SteamCMD..."
curl -fsSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz \
    | tar -xz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd

echo "==> Downloading Funcom Dune: Awakening server depot (app $SRCDS_APPID)..."
echo "    Depot is ~5 GB compressed; extracts to ~12 GB. Anonymous-accessible."
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
# Mirror conan_exiles' working pattern: chown /mnt to root, set HOME so
# SteamCMD's state goes to a known path. Unquoted login args so empty
# STEAM_PASS / STEAM_AUTH drop out (otherwise SteamCMD rejects with
# "Missing configuration"). +logoff before +quit per the working
# community guide.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
./steamcmd.sh \
    +force_install_dir /mnt/server/server \
    +login $STEAM_USER $STEAM_PASS $STEAM_AUTH \
    +app_info_update 1 \
    +app_update $SRCDS_APPID validate \
    +logoff \
    +quit

if [ ! -d /mnt/server/server/images ]; then
    echo "ERROR: SteamCMD finished but /mnt/server/server/images/ is missing." >&2
    echo "       Check the SteamCMD log above for errors." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "==> Fetching CubeCoders launch scripts from AMPTemplates @ main..."
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CubeCoders/AMPTemplates/main/duneawakeningupdates.json \
    | jq -r '.[0].UpdateSourceData' \
    | base64 -d \
    | tar -xz -C /mnt/server/
chmod +x /mnt/server/scripts/*.sh /mnt/server/scripts/mock-k8s-go

echo "==> Extracting Funcom OCI images and patching binary loaders..."
echo "    This may take several minutes with no visible output."
cd /mnt/server
ln -snfr server depot
bash scripts/install.sh /mnt/server

# install.sh writes a stray customstart.sh outside /mnt/server (an AMP-
# specific hook path that doesn't survive into the runtime container).
# The yolk image owns the equivalent setup (K8s ServiceAccount mount),
# so drop the leftover.
rm -f /mnt/customstart.sh

echo "==> Install complete."
echo "    Runtime image will start with: bash scripts/console.sh /home/container"

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Funcom dedicated-server depot to install. 4754530 = Production (retail); 3104830 = Public Test (PTC). Both are anonymous-accessible — no Steam ownership required.

variables.name: Release Version
variables.description: Must match Steam App ID. Used by prestart.sh to select retail vs beta FLS environment.

variables.name: Self-Host Service Token (JWT)
variables.description: Funcom JWT from https://account.duneawakening.com/ (retail) or https://account-pts.duneawakening.com/ (PTC). TREAT AS A SECRET. Each running battlegroup needs its own unique token.

variables.name: World Title
variables.description: Display name in the in-game server browser.

variables.name: World Name Override
variables.description: Optional. Paste a previously FLS-registered WorldName to keep the same battlegroup identity after wiping state. Leave blank to auto-generate on first boot.

variables.name: Datacenter ID
variables.description: Free-form label for FLS provider identification.

variables.name: Bind IP
variables.description: What internal services bind to inside the container. Almost always 0.0.0.0.

variables.name: External (Public) IP
variables.description: Your public WAN IP, advertised to clients via FLS. Required.

variables.name: Game Port Base (UDP)
variables.description: Base UDP port for the UE5 instance pool. Funcom uses 7777; Wings allocates 7777-7806 (30 slots) for this server.

variables.name: RabbitMQ Game Port (TCP/TLS)
variables.description: TLS AMQP endpoint advertised to clients via FLS. Default 5673.

variables.name: RabbitMQ Game Mgmt Port (TCP)
variables.description: HTTP management endpoint for client token auth. Default 15673.
